title: Writing: Four Lines, and the Joint You Do Not Write
label: ch:ja-writing-four-lines
canDo: I can write four connected lines of Japanese to a named friend, walking through my day with time words and naming who does it at most once.

payoff.summary: Complete JA-W145-four-lines: a greeting and three lines of your day in order, each opening on a time word and closing on a polite verb, then count how many lines name who does it.
payoff.note: The track teaches no Japanese conjunction yet, and the lesson does not smuggle one in. The lines hold together by a time word at the front of each and by the subject Japanese leaves out once it is clear, which chapter 138 already taught.
